videos.video_subject: Ronaldo replied to Messi's Instagram post after Argentina farewell: 'Leo, after so many years of defending your country, you've made history that will last forever... utmost respect... A hug'
videos.video_script: Cristiano Ronaldo just sent Lionel Messi a message. After Messi played his last game for Argentina, Ronaldo replied to his Instagram post. He wrote, Leo, after so many years of defending your country, you've made history that will last forever. He added, I have the utmost respect for what you've accomplished. He signed off with a hug. After all those years of rivalry, this is what Ronaldo chose to say. Is this the end of football's greatest rivalry?
